name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码(引用market) constraint: FOREIGN KEY, UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_config comment: '字段配置(JSON: enabled)' constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_order comment: 字段顺序(JSON) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_i18n_keys comment: 字段国际化文案Key(JSON) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: address_field_validation_rules comment: 地址字段校验规则 note: '技术校验(格式/长度)，按priority顺序执行。唯一约束: (country_code, field_name, rule_type, priority)' columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_name comment: 字段名(引用address_field_meta) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_type comment: 规则类型(pattern/length/custom) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 执行优先级(值小先执行) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: pattern comment: 正则表达式(pattern/custom时使用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: min_length comment: 最小长度(length时使用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: max_length comment: 最大长度(length时使用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: execute_on comment: 执行端(client/server/both) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: severity comment: 严重程度(error/warning) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: required_level comment: 必填性(required/optional/conditional) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: error_message_i18n_key comment: 多语言key constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: administrative_division comment: 行政区划层级 note: 各国行政区划树形数据(州/市/区)，支撑下拉选择 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: level comment: 层级(1=州/省 2=市 3=区) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: code comment: 行政区划代码 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name_local comment: 本地语言名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: parent_id comment: 父级ID(自引用) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序权重 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: postal_code_mapping comment: 邮编映射表 note: 邮编→城市/州反查，前端用于城市/州/邮编联动校验。导入时校验state_code须存在于administrative_division(level=1) columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: postal_code comment: 邮政编码 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: city comment: 城市 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: state_code comment: 州/省代码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user comment: 用户(外部) note: 用户模块提供，地址库引用user_id columns: - name: id comment: 用户ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: email comment: 邮箱 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 账户状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country comment: 国家(market模块) note: MARKET模块提供，地址库引用country_code columns: - name: country_code comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 国家名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_code comment: 货币代码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: user to: address type: 1:N label: 拥有多个地址 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.8 - from: country to: address type: 1:N label: 地址所属国家 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: country_address_config type: '1:1' label: 国家字段配置 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: address_field_validation_rules type: 1:N label: 校验规则(按国家) color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: postal_code_mapping type: 1:N label: 邮编数据 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: administrative_division type: 1:N label: 行政区划数据 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: administrative_division to: administrative_division type: 1:N label: 父子层级(自引用) color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed - from: address_field_meta to: country_address_config type: 1:N label: field_config引用字段元数据 color: '#2E7D32' penwidth: 1.4 style: dashed - from: address_field_meta to: address_field_validation_rules type: 1:N label: field_name引用元数据 color: '#2E7D32' penwidth: 1.4 - from: address_field_meta to: administrative_division type: 1:N label: admin_division_level映射 color: '#2E7D32' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed design_rules: superset_fields: 超集字段设计：数据库包含所有国家字段，通过country_address_config控制展示 field_registry: address_field_meta是字段的单一事实来源，后台配置页从此表读取可选字段列表 admin_division_mapping: admin_division_level数据驱动行政区划映射：state_province→L1, city→L2, district→L3，不硬编码 market_integration: 国家可用性引用market模块，地址库不独立维护国家列表 frontend_i18n: 前端多语言采用i18n方案，数据库不存储多语言字段 name_split: recipient_first_name + recipient_last_name 拆分存储，支持支付AVS和物流API name_concat: recipient_name 冗余存储拼接结果，拼接顺序由country_address_config.name_format控制 address_type_enum: 'address_type 枚举值: shipping, billing' verified_source_enum: 'verified_source 枚举值: google, usps, loqate' soft_delete: 地址数据支持软删除(CCPA要求可彻底删除) encryption: phone_number, recipient_first_name, recipient_last_name 字段 AES-256 加密存储 place_id_dedup: 通过 place_id 做地址去重(V1.1) mvp_scope: 'MVP只启用美国(US)，预留字段: alternate_phone_*, district, building_name, verified_*' snapshot_ownership: 订单地址快照(order_address_snapshot)由订单模块管理，不在地址库ER图中体现 validation_execute_on: execute_on区分前后端：client=前端实时校验, server=后端提交校验, both=前后端都执行 validation_severity: severity区分拦截级别：error=硬拦截阻止保存, warning=软提示允许继续 multi_rule_validation: 同一字段支持多条校验规则，按priority顺序执行，命中首个失败即返回对应error_message rule_type_enum: 'rule_type 枚举值: pattern(正则格式), length(长度范围), custom(自定义正则)' required_level_in_rules: 'required_level 统一在 address_field_validation_rules 中管理，枚举值: required/optional/conditional。field_config 不再承载必填性' field_config_structure: 'field_config JSON结构: {field_name: {enabled: bool}}，enabled=是否在该国启用此字段。field_name必须存在于address_field_meta' error_message_i18n_only: 校验规则错误提示统一使用 error_message_i18n_key，不存储硬编码文案，前端按key渲染多语言
